title: Sales Manager, Product - Link
description:
Sales Manager, Link

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow revenue, and pursue new business opportunities.

Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet. There is significant work ahead, and an opportunity to help make the global economy more accessible while doing meaningful work.

About the team

Link is Stripe’s consumer payments product. It helps consumers check out quickly and securely by saving their payment details, while helping businesses improve conversion and offer more payment options.

The Link sales team works with businesses to identify where Link can improve their checkout experience and support revenue growth. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success, Solutions Architecture, and other go-to-market teams to bring Link to more businesses and consumers.

What you’ll do

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of Account Executives responsible for driving Link adoption and revenue growth.

• Set clear goals and operating rhythms for the team, including pipeline management, account planning, forecasting, and opportunity reviews.

• Partner with Account Executives on account strategy, executive engagement, business cases, commercial negotiations, and complex deals.

• Build a high-performing team by hiring, onboarding, developing, and retaining strong sales talent.

• Work with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success, and Solutions Architecture to improve the Link sales motion and address customer needs.

• Help define the customer segments, use cases, and sales strategies where Link can have the greatest commercial impact.

• Develop strong relationships with senior customer stakeholders and represent Link in strategic customer conversations.

• Use customer feedback and market insight to inform product priorities, positioning, enablement, and go-to-market plans.

• Maintain a detailed understanding of Link, the checkout and payments landscape, and the factors that affect customer conversion and payment performance.

• Contribute to the broader sales organization through talent development, process improvements, and cross-functional leadership.

Minimum requirements

• 7+ years of sales experience, including experience selling technical products or platforms to complex organizations.

• 2+ years of people-management experience leading and developing quota-carrying sellers.

• A track record of building and leading high-performing sales teams against ambitious revenue goals.

• Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, including executive-level relationships and commercial negotiations.

• Experience developing account strategies and sales plans across multiple business units within large or complex organizations.

• Ability to understand technical products, payment flows, and customer business requirements, and to translate them into clear commercial value.

• Strong coaching, hiring, performance-management, and talent-development skills.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including executive presentations.

• Ability to work effectively in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment.

• Strong interest in payments, checkout experiences, consumer products, and technology.

title: Head of Technical Operations and Clinical Engineering
description:
Cardiosense is a rapidly growing, venture-backed medical AI company that is redefining how we detect, monitor, and manage heart disease. We're developing novel wearable sensors and advanced machine learning algorithms that translate raw physiological signals into clinically actionable, digital biomarkers used to detect early signs of cardiac worsening, guide personalized therapy, and improve patient outcomes.
Our team brings together experts in data science, biosignal analysis, and medicine united by a common mission to identify and combat preventable cardiac disease. Cardiosense 's solutions are built on over a decade of clinical research and we continue to collaborate with the world's leading academic institutions to introduce the next generation of cardiac monitoring and disease management.
About the role:
The Head Technical Operations and Clinical Engineering role is essential in developing innovative solutions that provide clinically relevant insights from non-invasive sensors for Cardiosense . Your work will directly impact the advancement of healthcare technologies and improve patient outcomes, making a significant difference in the medical field.

Responsibilities:

Deployment and Customer Integration

• Own end-to-end deployment of Cardiosense deployment for new customers, from technical scoping through go-live and steady-state support

• Serve as the primary point of contact to hospital IT, biomed/clinical engineering, and information security teams.

• Define and maintain the on-boarding procedures including device procurement and provisioning, fleet management, workflow mapping, and staff training.

• Manage integration workstreams with hospital systems and third-party cardiac data platforms, coordinating with engineering on interfacing requirements and data flow.

• Build the field support model, including tiering, SLAs, and the feedback to R&D.

Commercial & Performance Monitoring

• Support Commercial to define a successful deployment including activation milestones, sustained utilization thresholds, and per-site economics.

• Own instrumentation and reporting of device and platform usage, building the metrics infrastructure and recurring reporting cadence used by Commercial for account decisions.

• Own account monitoring across deployed sites including utilization, workflow breakdowns, or technical friction to allow for early intervention

• Translate deployment and utilization data into commercial strategy inputs and use that analysis to contribute to commercial planning.

• Own technical and operation content to customer-facing materials that helps solution expansion and increases site utilization

Hardware supply and manufacturing operations

• Manage the contract manufacturing and external design partners: statement of works, build plan, cost, yield, and quality

• Drive the accessory and device improvements roadmap through partners from requirements through design transfer and verification

• Own build planning and inventory across the demo program, clinical studies, and commercial deployment.

Clinical Engineering

• Support execution of clinical validation studies demonstrating performance and clinical utility of Cardiosense solutions, with commercialization endpoint defined early on.

• Provide operational and technical support to clinical studies, including site activation, device logistics, and data integrity.

• Provide oversight on data monitoring and execution, flagging when sites drift out of protocol early

Product and R&D Insights and Support

• Provide real-world usage into prioritized requirements for the algorithm and applications team

• Identify data collection opportunities that support algorithm improvements and expansion indications, in coordination with the PCCP framework

• Advise on product roadmap tradeoffs where deployment feasibility, manufacturability, or clinical utilization are gating factors.

About Omega Bio-tek
OUR HISTORY
Since its founding in 1998, Omega Bio-tek has been at the forefront of nucleic acid purification by offering products for clinical and basic research, biotechnology, and agricultural applications. DNA and RNA extraction is the first step for so many downstream analyses, and efficient and clean nucleic isolation is crucial. Our goal is to offer high-quality products to help you improve your workflows.
For the best option for all of your extraction needs, we offer multiple nucleic acid extraction chemistries including magnetic beads, silica membranes, and salting out. These three different methods are available in a wide range of different kits and configurations for a total of over 900 products.
Omega Bio-tek’s headquarters are located in Norcross, Georgia, about 25 miles outside of downtown Atlanta. We own and operate a 38,000 ft2 facility. We offer products for manual and automated processing and we support our customers by having Hamilton Microlab® STAR™, Beckman Coulter Biomek® FX, and Thermo KingFisher® instruments in-house.

Es un profesional especializado en el desarrollo, integración y adaptación de sistemas operativos embebidos (como Embedded Linux o RTOS) para ECUs (Unidades de Control Electrónico), con enfoque en la replicación y optimización de un Test OS en plataformas automotrices.
¿Cómo lo hace?
Analiza y porta el Test OS (usado para pruebas, diagnósticos y validación) de vehículos Gen2 a Gen1, adaptando su arquitectura, servicios y flujo de despliegue.
Desarrolla capas de abstracción de software para garantizar la compatibilidad entre el Test OS y el hardware de las ECUs.
Integra funcionalidades clave como diagnósticos (UDS, DoIP), flasheo de firmware, adquisición de datos (logging) y monitoreo de salud en tiempo real.
Automatiza pruebas (SIL, HIL y a nivel vehicular) para validar el comportamiento de las ECUs y los componentes conectados.
Depura problemas entre capas (software, hardware, comunicación) y colabora con equipos multidisciplinarios para cerrar brechas de plataforma.
¿Por qué es crucial?
Su trabajo asegura que los sistemas embebidos en vehículos Gen1 funcionen con la misma robustez y capacidad de prueba que los de Gen2, garantizando calidad, seguridad y cumplimiento de estándares automotrices (ej: ASPICE, MISRA C).
Requirements
Habilidades:
Lenguajes: C (avanzado +5 años), C++ (intermedio/avanzado 3-5+ años), Python (intermedio 2-5 años), Bash (intermedio 2-5 años).
Sistemas operativos embebidos: Embedded Linux (avanzado +5 años), RTOS (avanzado +5 años).
Protocolos de comunicación: CAN, CAN FD, UDS (avanzado +5 años), DoIP, Automotive Ethernet (intermedio 2-5 años).
Herramientas: Vector CANoe/CANalyzer/CANape (avanzado +5 años), GDB, JTAG (intermedio/avanzado 3-5+ años).
Pruebas automatizadas: GoogleTest, pytest (intermedio/avanzado 3-5+ años), SIL, HIL (avanzado +5 años).
CI/CD y control de versiones: Git (avanzado +5 años), Jenkins, GitLab CI (intermedio/avanzado 3-5+ años).
Firmware para ECUs: Integración, flasheo, diagnósticos (DIDs, DTCs) (avanzado +5 años).
Estándares: ASPICE, MISRA C (avanzado +5 años).
Visa (Obligatorio) - Viajaran a USA por el equipo de cliente
Actividades del puesto:
Análisis y adaptación del Test OS:
Analizar la arquitectura, servicios y flujo de despliegue del Test OS implementado en vehículos Gen2.
Portar el Test OS a las ECUs Gen1 de RVT, asegurando compatibilidad con el hardware existente.
Desarrollo de software embebido:
Desarrollar capas de abstracción de plataforma para facilitar la comunicación, control y monitoreo de las ECUs.
Implementar módulos de software para integración de diagnósticos, flasheo de firmware y adquisición de datos.
Integración de funcionalidades clave:
Integrar diagnósticos de ECU (DIDs, DTCs) usando protocolos como UDS y DoIP.
Implementar rutinas de flasheo de firmware para actualizaciones seguras en las ECUs.
Configurar sistemas de logging y monitoreo de salud para registrar y analizar datos en tiempo real.
Automatización de pruebas:
Diseñar y desarrollar pruebas SIL (Software-in-the-Loop) para validar el software en entornos simulados.
Crear pruebas HIL (Hardware-in-the-Loop) para validar el software en conjunto con hardware real.
Implementar pruebas a nivel vehicular para validar el comportamiento del sistema en condiciones reales.
Depuración y resolución de problemas:
Depurar problemas entre capas (software, hardware, comunicación) en las ECUs.
Colaborar con equipos de ECU, eléctrica, sistemas, validación y hardware para identificar y resolver brechas de plataforma.
Colaboración y documentación:
Trabajar con equipos multidisciplinarios para asegurar la integración y validación del Test OS en Gen1.
Documentar procesos, cambios y resultados de las pruebas y adaptaciones realizadas.
Cumplimiento de estándares:
Asegurar que el desarrollo del software cumpla con estándares como ASPICE y MISRA C.
Validar que las soluciones implementadas cumplan con los requisitos de seguridad y calidad del cliente.

title: Senior Product Manager (AI CICD)
description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk. 

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

Senior Product Manager, AI CI/CD

The role, in a nutshell:

Chainguard secures the software supply chain, and we're standing up a new team to build a new product inside it.

Agents now write a large and growing share of the world's code, and they inherited a CI system designed for humans who push a few times a day. Write, push, wait in a queue, reinstall the same toolchain, scrape the logs, try again. Agents iterate far more often than people do, so they feel every minute of that, and the workarounds they've grown are worse than the thing they're working around. We don't think the fix is a faster version of the CI you already have. We think CI gets rebuilt for agents, and that's what we're doing.

The product isn't launched, so a job post is the wrong place for the details. What we can tell you now: the team is small, the hard technical pieces already run in production inside Chainguard, and you'd be driving the product direction. 

What you'll own:

• Strategy and roadmap. Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the product. Decide what we build first, what comes next, and what we're not going to do.

• 0→1 product work. Take this from a system that works for us to a product customers buy and use. Bring structure to problems that don't have any yet, make the tradeoff calls, and get things in front of users before they feel finished.

• How agents actually build software. Go deep on how developers and their agents write, test, review, and ship code today, including the parts nobody blogs about. Most of what's written about agentic development is aspirational. You'll work from what people really do.

• Design partners. Find the teams whose agent fleets are big enough to hurt, get the product into their hands early, and turn what they tell you into priorities.

• Developer experience. Adoption is the whole game here. Own how the product gets tried, configured, and lived with, so a team can move onto it without running a migration project.

• Launch. Positioning, naming, docs, the pricing model, and the story, with Product Marketing and the rest of Product. You're also the person who says when it's ready.

• Cross-functional leadership. Partner with Engineering, Experience, Product Marketing, and other Product leaders, and keep a small team pointed at the same thing while the space shifts underneath it.

What we're looking for:

• 5+ years of product management experience on developer-facing, infrastructure, security, or similarly technical products.

• You've built agent tools. Something agents use, or something people use to build with agents: a coding agent, an agent framework or harness, MCP servers, eval systems, or developer tooling meant to be driven by a model instead of a person. This is the requirement that matters most to us.

• You know CI from the inside. Builds, tests, caches, runners, artifacts, merge gates, and the specific reasons pipelines end up slow, flaky, and expensive. You should have opinions about why.

• You don't need to be a GitHub Actions expert. We're not building a better Actions, and years of workflow YAML isn't the experience we're hiring for. Knowing where it breaks is.

• Experience taking a technical product from an early idea through launch and iteration.

• Judgment about what to leave out. A new product dies from doing too much as easily as from doing too little.

title: Senior JavaScript Engineer (Full-stack, Retention)
description:

Relay Commerce is an e-commerce enablement platform offering scaling solutions across personalized messaging, social commerce, and customer retention, helping merchants navigate the rapidly evolving digital landscape with a comprehensive suite of tools. The Relay suite of solutions currently drives more than $1 billion in aggregate incremental gross merchandise volume for more than 35,000 merchants.

About the Role

This is a primarily back-end role (~70%) where you will design and evolve TypeScript services that power personalized replenishment, cross-sell, and subscription offers used by Shopify stores processing millions of transactions.

You will own features end-to-end, shaping the problem with a Senior Product Manager, proposing the architecture, implementing the solution with the support of AI, and monitoring and operating it in production. These systems need to be reliable, observable, maintainable, and performant.

You will effectively use AI agents such as Claude code and Codex to deliver at pace.

You will also contribute to our React-based front-ends (~30%) when delivering features as part of an experienced multi-functional team.

Relo, a Relay company, helps consumer goods and subscription brands unlock more than 30% additional revenue from their existing customers. The platform gets one-time buyers to order again, turns more customers into subscribers, and keeps them loyal. It does this through an engine that predicts when each customer is ready to reorder, making recurring revenue easy for scaling Shopify merchants.
Primary Responsibilities

• Work as part of a skilled, AI-native, multi-disciplined product engineering team to rapidly deliver modern software, to excellent quality standards, across high-volume subscription and billing systems.

• Design and deliver serverless TypeScript services on AWS Lambda, backed by MySQL and Prisma ORM.

• Contribute to efficient, modern React applications which rely on our APIs and integrate with the Shopify and Klaviyo ecosystems.

• Own features end-to-end, working with your team to make sure we ship solutions to real customer problems.

• Support our Customer Success team by joining our working hours escalation schedule, operating and maintaining the live production system.

• Participate in architectural discussions and technical decision making across Relo and the rest of Relay Commerce .

• Add agent context to codebases, run coding agents, build MCPs and AI product features to open our platform to LLMs such as Shopify’s Sidekick.

• Contribute improvements to processes, guidelines, and documentation in a fully-remote organisation.

Important Traits for Success

• You are comfortable taking loosely defined product ideas and turning them into concrete technical solutions.

• You effectively use AI agents such as Claude code or Codex to deliver working, reliable software at pace. You understand and can explain skills, MCP’s, RAG and other aspects of AI tooling. You know when to delegate to Claude and Codex, and when not to.

• You communicate clearly in writing. Design proposals, pull requests, and technical discussions should be concise and easy for other engineers to follow.

• You consider the operational impact of the systems you build. You think about reliability, observability, security, and performance before and during development.

• You are comfortable working across the stack when needed; front-end with React, back-end with REST APIs and CLI scripts, in the database, with infrastructure-as-code, or with cloud-native services.

• You take accountability

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Ajaia is an AI implementation consultancy and product studio. We help organizations move from AI experimentation to measurable return on investment across four practices: AI Strategy and Advisory, Workforce Training and Enablement, Process Optimization, and Custom AI Development. Our work sits with executives and the people who do the actual work, and it is judged on whether something changed in production, not on whether a pilot looked good in a deck.
Position Overview
Ajaia is hiring a remote Technical Project Manager to run delivery on client AI builds from kickoff to a system that actually works in production. You will triage the pile of requests that lands on your desk this week, keep a mess of moving parts organized without dropping a thread, and know enough about the code to call out what will not hold up before a client ever sees it. You are not the person who decided what to build. You are the person who makes sure it gets built, on time, on scope, and honestly reported the whole way through.
This is a technical seat with a delivery mandate. You should be able to sit down and build a working automation yourself when that is faster than explaining to someone else what to build. We care far more about what you can build and run than how long you have held a title.
You will run delivery for US clients with a team based in New York. Client calls, standups, and escalations happen on US Eastern time, so this role is built around daily overlap with the US team, not asynchronous handoffs.
Compensation: Competitive, benchmarked to senior delivery roles in your market, plus a performance bonus tied to delivery outcomes. We will share a specific number for your location early in the process.
How we expect you to work
AI use is a core execution requirement at Ajaia, not optional tooling. You will use AI daily to draft status updates, stand up small automations, generate test data, and get a first pass on a code review, then apply your own judgment on top. Project managers at Ajaia write code: a script that cleans up a messy dataset, an automation that wires two systems together. You should be able to do that yourself, and comfortable saying when an AI-generated first draft is wrong.
Staying current on new tools is part of the job, and so is being straight with people: an engineer on a technical risk, a client on a date.
Remote works here when the writing is strong. Status, risks, and decisions get written down where the team and the client can read them, not held until the next call.
What you will do

• Build working automations and scripts yourself when that solves the problem faster than a meeting would.

• Read the code. Call out specifically what will break in production, not just whether the ticket is checked off.

• Keep a lot of moving parts straight at once: the backlog, the risk list, three overlapping deadlines, and whichever client is calling today.

• Triage ruthlessly. A pile of requests lands every week, and deciding what gets worked now and what waits is most of the job.

• Write to clients like a person. Plain, specific, and honest, especially when the news is not great.

• Run client calls and standups on US Eastern time and be reachable during the overlap window when something breaks.

• Own the delivery plan for your engagements end to end: sequencing, dependencies, and the date.

• Unblock technical decisions inside the team, then live with the consequence of the call you made.

• Escalate risks as soon as you see them, not after they have already cost the date.

• Define done for a deliverable before the engineer starts building it, not after they finish.

• Stay on the number after go-live long enough to know whether adoption is real or the dashboard is lying

Requirements

• Highly organized across many moving parts at once: a backlog, several risks, more than one client.

• Reads code and specs well enough to say what will break in production.

• Builds small automations and scripts to solve problems fast.

• Build dashboards and analytical tools in Omni Analytics that clinicians and operational leaders actually use to make decisions.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Data Center Engineering team designs training and inference compute clusters from first principles, pushing thermal, electrical, and optical systems to the limit of physics. We operate as a highly cross-disciplinary team of mechanical, electrical, optical, and software engineers, all working to maximize the efficiency, reliability, and deployment speed of terrestrial computing to serve rapidly scaling demand.

This team owns compute architecture, datacenter network design, rack builds, connectivity, in-house design of our own computers, and the manufacturing line that builds that compute. RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Own end-to-end optical and fiber design for AI training and inference fabrics: fiber cabling, cassette/panel architecture, polarity, breakout, reach, and connector strategy (MPO-12/16, SN, MDC, LC, OSFP / QSFP-DD)

• Write and verify link budgets for scale-out and scale-up interconnect (SMF/MMF, AOC/DAC, DR/FR/LR, InfiniBand and Ethernet), including loss, reflections, FEC, and realistic install margins

• Evolve connectivity toward the next speed and density (800G / 1.6T, CPO/NPO awareness, tighter reaches, higher fiber count per rack)

•  Work with mechanical and network teams to design structured cabling and raceways with the rack and facilities teams: tray fill, bend radius, pre-term vs field-term, labeling, and a plant that can be built and repaired at hall scale

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, optical engineering, physics, or a related engineering discipline

• 2+ years of professional experience in fiber layout, optical link design, and/or datacenter/HPC optical engineering

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Demonstrated ownership of fiber or optical design that was installed and turned up in a datacenter, HPC, or AI-compute environment

• Working command of single-mode vs multimode, MPO polarity, insertion/return loss, and 100G+ transceiver classes

• Hands-on optical test: inspect/clean, power meter, OTDR or equivalent

• Fiber interconnect ownership for AI / high-compute clusters (GPU scale-out fabric, InfiniBand NDR/XDR, RoCE Ethernet 400/800G)

• High-density pre-terminated trunk/cassette design and rack-to-spine optical mapping at hall scale

Do it well and our teams get systems that work together, so tradespeople and homeowners get a smoother experience.

The job, unfiltered:

- Design, build and maintain solutions across Apex, LWC and advanced declarative features, mainly in Sales and Service Cloud, plus Zuora, Retool, Braze CRM and Node/TypeScript services on Kubernetes on GCP.

- Use AI coding tools with confidence to move faster without cutting corners on quality.

- Architect secure, scalable integrations between Salesforce and our other core services, including inbound and outbound REST APIs and platform event-driven workflows.

- Work alongside distributed engineering and data teams to keep data flowing cleanly and the architecture cohesive, bringing your Salesforce knowledge into the wider engineering conversation.

- Own and improve the deployment pipelines across Salesforce and other services, so releases to production are smooth, automated and reliable.

- Champion code quality: write thorough tests, run solid code reviews and help others get the best out of AI-assisted development.

The fit:

- Solid, hands-on professional software engineering experience, including strong Salesforce development across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and Salesforce DevOps.

- A track record of clean, asynchronous Apex (triggers, batch, queueable), responsive LWC components and complex Flows, backed by solid engineering skills beyond the platform.

- A genuine handle on AI-driven coding: you know how to give AI models the right architectural context, schemas and constraints to get accurate, secure, production-ready code back.

- Hands-on experience with enterprise integration patterns (large data volumes, platform events, API error handling).

- Experience managing CI/CD pipelines, change management and environment refreshes.

What you get

💰 Competitive salary, annual bonus & equity scheme

🩺 Health, wellbeing and learning support

🚲 Gym membership, Smart Tech Scheme, Cycle Scheme

🎂 Birthday/special day leave, buy & sell holiday scheme

❤️ 1 week's paid charity leave, and more

How this goes

- Screening call with one of our Talent Acquisition Partners

- First stage interview with the Director of Engineering

- Second stage interview with a Staff Engineer and a Senior Salesforce Engineer

- Final stage interview with a Product Manager

We’re Checkatrade - the UK’s leading platform for finding a tradesperson. With more than 50,000 trades listed and over 6 million reviews, we help homeowners get jobs done right and help tradespeople grow their business.

We’re growing fast, with big plans to become the go-to brand for home improvements. If you care about great work, take pride in the details, and want to make an impact, you’ll fit right in.

title: Director of Developer Experience - Platform Engineering (x/f/m)
description:
The opportunity

Founded in 2013, Doctolib is Europe's leading AI and digital health company, serving 520,000 health professionals and 90 million people. We are building a new way to build software: agents doing the grunt work of writing, testing, reviewing and merging code, with engineers moving into a control-tower role to monitor and intervene.

Your mission: build the tooling and workflows that let AI agents and the engineers who work alongside them  test, review, ship and monitor code reliably, so Doctolib can multiply its engineering output while keeping quality and control.

The role

We're looking for a Director of Developer Experience to lead our new AI Developer Experience team, reporting to the VP Platform Engineering. You will also own the existing CI and Developer Experience scope.

Doctolib is moving AI adoption from a temporary SWAT team to a permanent capability. The current team includes two Product Managers and two engineers, with more people joining through internal transfers and hiring.

Your team will own:

• The agent-native testing and feedback infrastructure that lets agents know, within their own workflow, whether what they built is correct.

• CI/CD and build systems for the monolith and satellite services, elevated from a CI-run team into an efficient agent-testing capability.

• Developer productivity measurement in the AI era DORA, autonomous change rate and complementary indicators.

• Own testing and feedback for the monolith and satellite services, elevating the current CI setup from a CI-run team into an efficient agent-testing capability.

• Own developer productivity measurement in the context of AI - DORA, autonomous change rate and complementary indicators - and make it visible and actionable to feature teams.

• Lead the inner-loop experience: local and remote environments, onboarding, editor integration and sandboxing.

• Build and organise the team, developing agentic skills internally where needed, as AI adoption shifts from a temporary SWAT team to a permanent one.

• Partner with Product Engineering and Product Management to understand internal users and drive adoption.

Your team

Reporting to the VP Platform Engineering, Mike Aidane , you'll join the Platform Engineering leadership team alongside directors and senior EMs for Application Platform, Data Services and Platform Services. You will lead the new AI Developer Experience team . You'll partner closely with Product Engineering, Product Management, Release Engineering, Quality Engineering, Automation Platform, Infrastructure Platform, SRE, FinOps, Security, Privacy and Compliance, and engineering teams across France and Germany.

Your profile

You have led engineering organisations through large-scale Developer Experience transformations and know what it takes to ship great tooling fast, durably, and without sacrificing quality. You think in systems technical and organisational and are as comfortable setting architecture direction as you are making a hard technical call.

Core qualifications:

• You have led Developer Experience, Developer Productivity, Developer Infrastructure or Build/CI organisations serving 300+ engineers. You have demonstrated measurable change in how engineers work, with evidence of adoption, productivity outcomes and organisational or operating-model change.

• You have deep technical credibility across CI/CD, build and test infrastructure, monorepo build graphs, test selection, caching, merge queues and flake management. You can guide architecture and trade-offs while remaining credible with Staff E

title: Junior Fraud Analyst (Night Shift)
description:
About the role
Capitex is hiring Junior Fraud Analysts on a remote, short-term contract to support the Digital Fraud Operations team of a leading bank in the Middle East.
You will join a shift-based team covering evening and overnight hours, monitoring and responding to suspicious activity across the bank's digital channels. Working alongside the bank's in-house fraud analysts, you will be the first line of defence protecting customers from fraud out of hours.

•
Contract: approx. 2 months, with potential for extension

•
Location: remote

•
Shifts: evening and night rota

•
Equipment: laptop provided

Key responsibilities

• Monitor and triage real-time fraud alerts across card, online banking, mobile banking and payment channels.

• Review flagged transactions and account activity to identify genuine fraud and close false positives.

• Contact customers to verify suspicious transactions, following the bank's authentication procedures.

• Take immediate protective action where required, such as blocking cards, holding payments or restricting account access.

• Escalate complex, high-value or confirmed fraud cases to L2 analysts and investigators in line with escalation protocols.

• Record clear, accurate case notes and decisions on the case management system.

• Spot emerging fraud patterns and typologies and flag them to the wider team.

• Provide structured shift handovers so open cases are picked up without delay.

• Meet alert handling SLAs and quality standards while following the bank's policies and procedures.

Essential requirements

• 1 to 3 years' experience in a fraud operations, fraud monitoring or transaction monitoring role within banking, payments or fintech.

• Hands-on experience triaging fraud alerts and making clear genuine or fraud decisions.

• Solid understanding of common fraud types, including card fraud, account takeover, authorised push payment (APP) and social engineering scams.

• Experience using a fraud detection or case management system.

• Comfortable speaking with customers by phone to verify activity, calmly and professionally.

• Strong attention to detail and accurate, concise case note writing.

• Sound judgement under pressure and confidence acting quickly within set procedures.

• Fluent written and spoken English.

• Available to work evening and overnight shifts on a rota basis.

• Reliable home working setup with a stable internet connection and a quiet, private workspace.

Desirable

• Experience with fraud platforms such as FICO Falcon, NICE Actimize, Featurespace, Feedzai or similar.

• Experience working night shifts or out-of-hours rotas in a fraud or operations team.

• Arabic language skills.

• Exposure to GCC or Middle East retail banking.

• Understanding of card scheme rules and chargeback processes.

• A relevant certification, such as CFE or an ICA fraud qualification, or working towards one.

title: Senior/Staff System Research Engineer – LLM Inference Optimization
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for talented systems developers and researchers to join the Snowflake AI Research team and advance the state of the art in LLM inference systems and optimization.

Our mission is to build the next generation of high-performance and intelligent inference systems. We optimize not only how fast and efficiently models run, but also how quickly inference systems can adapt to new models, architectures, hardware, and workloads.

Our work spans the full inference stack-from distributed serving and runtime systems to GPU kernels and model-system co-design. We explore techniques such as adaptive parallelism, speculative and parallel decoding, disaggregated inference, scheduling and batching, KV-cache optimization, model swapping, quantization, and GPU kernel optimization to push the frontier of latency, throughput, scalability, and cost.

Beyond optimizing individual models, we are building intelligent and adaptive inference systems that can automate performance optimization-rapidly profiling new models and workloads, identifying bottlenecks, selecting effective execution strategies, and adapting system configurations with minimal manual tuning. We embrace AI-native engineering, using AI not only as the workload we optimize, but also as a tool to accelerate system development, experimentation, debugging, optimization, and adaptation to new models. Our goal is to accelerate both the speed of inference and the agility of inference development.

This is an exciting opportunity to collaborate with a world-class team, including founding members of DeepSpeed, vLLM, and TensorFlow. Together, we will push the boundaries of AI systems and bring cutting-edge research into production-scale AI.

Responsibilities

- Design and develop high-performance LLM inference systems, spanning distributed serving, runtime systems, GPU execution, and performance-critical kernels.

- Develop novel techniques to improve inference latency, generation speed, throughput, memory efficiency, scalability, and cost.

- Explore advanced inference techniques including speculative and parallel decoding, prefill/decode disaggregation, adaptive parallelism, continuous batching and scheduling, KV-cache management, quantization, and communication optimization.

- Develop adaptive and intelligent inference systems that automatically optimize execution for new model architectures, hardware platforms, workload characteristics, and deployment environments.

- Apply AI-driven and AI-native approaches to systems engineering, including automated profiling, bottleneck identification, configuration search, code generation, experimentation, runtime strategy selection, debugging, and performance tuning.

- Independently identify high-impact performance and systems problems, formulate hypotheses, prototype solutions, and drive promising ideas from research through production.

- Design distributed inference strategies across GPUs and nodes, including tensor, sequence, pipeline, data, and expert parallelism.

- Develop efficient approaches for multi-model serving, dynamic resource management, model loading and swapping, and workload-aware scheduling.

- Analyze and optimize GPU kernels and operators for attention, MoE, communication, and other performance-critical model components.

• Partner with functional teams during initiation, plan, design, procurement, deployment, and post deployment phases.

• Responsible for managing/tracking program milestones, timeline, and overall deliverables.

• Responsible for asset and material management across data centers and warehouses

• Engage in creating and maintaining comprehensive project documentation including schedules, reviews, process documents, risk analysis, etc.

• Participate in the definition of project scope and objectives, involving all relevant stakeholders and ensuring technical feasibility.

• Participate in driving project lifecycle milestones from concept commit through project closure and advocate change management.

• Use metrics and KPIs to measure project performance using appropriate tools and techniques, and provide regular status updates.

• Participate in internal process improvements; remove gaps across multiple teams and functions.

• Identify and track risks, execute risk analysis and risk management techniques, and provide risk mitigation strategies.

• Be a point of contact for vendor partners and internal stakeholders.

• Coordinate and drive regularly scheduled meetings with core teams.

• Take an active role in evaluation of post project results against metrics; recommend or implement changes to improve delivery practices/processes.

• Other duties as required. This list is not meant to be a comprehensive inventory of all responsibilities assigned to this position.

Required Qualifications/Skills:

• Bachelor’s degree (B.S/B.A) from four-college or university and 2 to 5 years’ related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience

• 2 to 5 years of project management experience in a high-pressure, and fast-paced environment, preferably supporting data centers or network hardware

• 2+ years of experience with data center lifecycles and/or large-scale networks

• Builds productive internal and external working relationships

• Exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action

• Understanding of project management teams, resolving conflict, and meeting schedule timelines

• Excellent communication skills (verbal, written, documentation)

• Ability to work on multiple projects and assignments concurrently

• Self-starter who is able to quickly learn new tools and gain familiarity with new processes and technologies with minimal assistance

• Experience creating spreadsheets, presentation material, and project/process documentation

• Strong observational and analytical skills, including: ability to collect, organize, analyze and disseminate significant amounts of information, strong attention to detail and accuracy, ability to track and report metrics, and manage risks

• Ability to collaborate with stakeholders and communicate project updates to client executives

• Willingness to work across multiple North American timezones (remotely or from the local client office)

Preferred Qualifications:

• Various certifications (PMP, PgMP, PfMP, PPM, CPD, CPMP, etc
